posts.title: New titles from RIP Peace, updated stock list
posts.description: Hi everyone! It's been a little while since I've updated. The summer felt busy between some shows that I had played, some shows I had booked, and working a little more. I've updated the stock list so it is at this moment correct. Many items are very low-stock, but for now it's accurate. posts.title: Upcoming Shows and stock update (or lack of)
posts.description: Hi there, sorry it's been so long since my last update. Summer has been busy as hell and you know how it goes. It was great seeing FAN CLUB again, and in a different setting. ZORN and SKALLAR both played a great show a few days after and it was exciting hearing new band PAINTED WOUND live. I've got two more shows coming up. posts.title: GENETIC ANGRY - Not Yet 7" now in stock
posts.description: I just got a few copies of the NEW 7" from GENETIC ANGRY from Truro, Nova Scotia. After many years living on oppositve coasts, the Mumfords have gotten back together to record new material. They made and released it themselves, and I'm very proud to distrubute some copies.
